correctness.rationale: The full proof fixes the domain, distinguishes U_M from the actual top, computes negated biconditionals via maximal traces, proves the iff condition for failing triples, and counts ordinary and endpoint complementary pairs without overlap. It separately counts precisely three WEM assignments. The direct residuation-based checker independently verifies all 2,463,045 ordered triples for m=1..7. Boundary m=1 has zero failures, and m>=2 has a concrete failure. Arbitrary m is proved analytically, not extrapolated from tests.

originality.rationale: The proposition-apartness classification of Kocsis gives the global validity iff-WEM criterion but not counts of assignments. Bumpus–Kocsis proves a different non-gap result for material implication using Boolean-plus-top algebras. Direct reading of the relevant full-text sections and explicit searches found neither the exact (2^m-2)(2^m+3) triple count nor the simultaneous opposite limiting degrees for WEM and cotransitivity. A general earlier equivalent calculation remains a risk; absence of search hits is not proof of novelty. A prior general finite-frame WEM/DNE spectrum already implies the WEM count used here; this known component is treated solely as context, not an original standalone formula.
residual_risks: The same elementary Boolean-plus-top family occurs in arXiv:2110.11515; an unpublished or differently named calculation of cotransitivity frequencies could have preceded this statement.
Semantic searches cannot establish global uniqueness; no independent literature auditor has verified novelty.
The exact rational expression is supported by a general proof, but the only empirical tests cover m=1..7.

value.rationale: The qualitative equivalence of global apartness cotransitivity and WEM from the primary 2022 reference naturally motivates whether near-universal cotransitivity forces WEM to be typically true. The theorem resolves that quantitative stability question negatively with exact rational formulas and opposite limits on an infinite natural family. It provides a concrete benchmark distinct from the previously studied two-variable material-implication gap and makes the sparse obstruction combinatorially transparent.
